description: This file provides utility functions for integrating with Google Calendar via OAuth through Supabase. It includes methods to retrieve access tokens, fetch calendar events, map raw Google events to internal meeting objects, and merge updates while avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: getGoogleAccessToken()
methods.description: Retrieves the current session's Google OAuth access token by inspecting multiple possible locations within the session object.

methods.name: fetchGoogleEvents({ accessToken, timeMin, timeMax, maxResults = 250, singleEvents = true, orderBy = 'startTime', calendarId = 'primary', } = {})
methods.description: Fetches calendar events from Google Calendar API within a specified time range, using the provided OAuth token.

methods.name: toMeetingObjects(events = [], userId)
methods.description: Converts raw Google Calendar event data into internal 'Meeting-like' objects suitable for storage or processing.

methods.name: mergeWithoutDuplicates(existing = [], incoming = [])
methods.description: Merges incoming meetings with existing ones, avoiding duplicates based on 'external_event_id'.

search-terms: Google OAuth token retrieval via session
fetching Google Calendar events with token
Mapping Google events to internal meeting objects
